_about: English text for tables.py. skill_names: display name by skill constant, as in skillnametable.txt. skill_desc: description lines by skill constant, as in skilldesctable.txt; these are the skills the minigame can show. items: by item number, the identified and unidentified name and description of each item the minigame hands out or sells. Names use _ for a space, as the tables do. Names follow the international client (iRO) except where the minigame renamed something: Aco_Smash, Aco_Kaboom, Aco_Tornado, Grrr, Toy_Chain.
